title: Casper and the Horizon
author: Lior Hartwell
blurb: Ulyana Galloway, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
